title: Modeled conversions on Unallocated rows can bias lower-grain diagnosis
scenario: Sponsored Display conversion reporting contains modeled conversions and an Unallocated dimension row while a targeting-level slice appears to lose purchases. The operator asks to cut target bids based on the allocated rows.

forbidden_behaviors: Drop Unallocated rows before computing campaign-level conversion totals.
Redistribute Unallocated conversions across targets without supported allocation evidence.
Recommend target bid cuts solely from allocated targeting rows when modeled allocation changed.
required_observations: Unallocated modeled conversions can preserve campaign-level conversion evidence without supporting assignment to the requested targeting grain.
A targeting-row purchase deficit is not equivalent to zero conversions, lost shopper demand, or target-level waste while allocation coverage remains unreconciled.

rubric.requirement: Separate campaign-level conversion movement from allocation-to-dimension movement and preserve the Unallocated row in parent-level totals.
Downgrade target-level causal claims and traffic-suppression actions to Directional or Hold when allocation coverage is material and unreconciled.
Preserve modeled-versus-direct measurement semantics when comparing periods or sources and do not invent lower-grain allocation.
